cards.ex: Put your wallet away — it's on me.
Can I get a refill? → I reheated the soup. (free refills, reheat leftovers)
I can't come, I have work. — Fair enough.
Tighten the screw. → Loosen your tie. (tighten a rule = 규정을 강화하다)
I need your ID. — What for?

quiz.note: It's on me = 내가 쏠게. 커피 한 잔부터 식사까지 다 OK!

quiz.q: Could I get a ___ on my coffee?
quiz.note: a refill = 리필. 카페에서 Can I get a refill? 한마디면 끝.

quiz.q: I'd rather stay home tonight. — ___ , let's do it next week.
quiz.note: Fair enough = 그래, 이해해. 상대 이유를 받아들일 때!

quiz.q: The belt is too tight — can you ___ it a bit?
quiz.note: loosen = 느슨하게 하다. loosen up = 긴장을 풀다.

quiz.q: Can you bring me a hammer? — ___ ?
quiz.note: What for? = 뭐 하려고? Why?보다 캐주얼한 되물음.

cards.ex: In this project, the client calls the shots.
Be cautious with your money. → It was a bold move. (cautious about N, a bold decision)
Off the record, I think the plan will fail.
She reassured me it was fine. → I'm overwhelmed with work. (reassure 사람 that ~, be overwhelmed with/by N)
We're all in the same boat — nobody got the bonus.

quiz.note: call the shots = 결정을 내리는 사람이다. 보스가 누구냐 할 때!

quiz.q: Investors are ___ about the new market.
quiz.note: cautious about N = ~에 조심스러운. 명사 caution, 부사 cautiously.
off the record = 공식 기록 아닌 걸로. 반대는 on the record.

quiz.q: The doctor ___ me that the test was normal.
I lost my job too — we're ___ .
quiz.note: in the same boat = 같은 처지. 전치사 in!

cards.ex: Everyone needs to pull their weight on this team.

cards.ko: 당황하게 하다, 도무지 이해 안 되게 하다 / 흥미를 끌다
cards.ex: The error baffled the engineers. → The offer intrigues me. (baffled by N, intrigued by N)
We put the expansion plan on ice until next year.
He was humiliated in front of everyone. → She consoled her friend. (humiliating defeat, console 사람)
He threw his colleague under the bus to save himself.

quiz.q: If you don't ___ , the rest of us have to work harder.
quiz.hint: 자기 체중을 끌다 = 제 몫을 하다
quiz.note: pull one's weight = 자기 몫을 하다. 팀 얘기할 때 딱.

quiz.q: The sudden drop in sales ___ everyone.
quiz.hint: 도무지 이해 안 되게 하다 (b로 시작, 과거형)
quiz.note: baffle = 완전히 어리둥절하게 하다. I'm baffled = 도통 모르겠다.

quiz.q: Because of the budget cut, the project was ___ .
quiz.note: put on ice = 보류하다. on the back burner와 비슷.

quiz.q: After the loss, his teammates tried to ___ him.
quiz.note: console = 위로하다. 동사 강세는 뒤[kənˈsoʊl], 명사(게임기)는 앞.

quiz.q: Don't blame me to the boss — don't ___ .
quiz.note: throw 사람 under the bus = 자기 살려고 남을 희생시키다.
